steps.en: Wrongly formatted notice number shows an error
steps.id: Nomor notice dengan format salah menampilkan error

steps.en: No match shows an error message
steps.id: Tidak ada yang cocok menampilkan pesan error
steps.why_en: The normal search only shows an empty table; an error message appears only for uploaded lists.
steps.why_id: Pencarian biasa hanya menampilkan tabel kosong; pesan error hanya muncul untuk daftar yang diunggah.

steps.en: Paid or cancelled notice shows an error
steps.id: Notice paid atau cancelled menampilkan error
steps.why_en: The search does not warn about paid or cancelled notices; the error only appears later when suspension is applied.
steps.why_id: Pencarian tidak memperingatkan notice paid atau cancelled; error baru muncul nanti saat suspension diterapkan.
